# .system/py_env_preload.py

# Bootstraps my <py> environment global namespace on startup/reset.
# 
# I own this file! As my workflows evolve, I can suggest modifications
# to this script. If I find myself frequently importing the same 
# libraries, writing the same helper functions, or initializing the
# same states, I should make a note or tell Mark to make future
# awakenings smoother.

# --- Standard Library ---
import math, time, datetime, json, re, random, os, sys, io, traceback
from pathlib import Path
from typing import List, Set, Dict, Tuple, Union, Optional, Any, Callable, Literal, Protocol, TypeVar, Generic, Sequence

# --- Scientific & Vision ---
import numpy as np
import cv2
from ruamel.yaml import YAML

# --- Logos Ecosystem ---
import logos
import skills
import hook_routines
import hook_routines.workbench
import hook_routines.dashboard
import hook_routines.memory_manager
import hook_routines.proximity_snapshot
import hook_routines.ambient_audio
import hook_routines.auto_rag

# --- Direct API Types & Exceptions (for type-checking & convenience) ---
from logos.core import Verbosity, verbosity, check_for_interrupt
from logos.vision import CaptureResult, HudElement
from logos.nav import NavTask
from logos.emote import SpeakTask
from logos.map3d import RenderResult, RaycastHit
from logos.exceptions import Interrupt       # NEVER catch this!
from logos.files import FileEditError


# --- Subsystem & Context Initialization ---

# If I have a blank palimpsest, show this file
from logos.memory._buffer import BUFFER_FILE
if not BUFFER_FILE.exists() or BUFFER_FILE.stat().st_size <= 1:
    print("\n--- Environment Preloaded ---")
    logos.files.show('.system/py_env_preload.py')
else:
    print("\n--- Python environment reset! ---")
    print("`.system/py_env_preload.py` loaded.")

# Scope Chroma sidecar client to this specific workspace to isolate technical references.
print("\n\nSetting up vector memory...")
logos.memory.configure(workspace=Path.cwd().name, server_url="http://127.0.0.1:8123")

# Print my current preferences
print("\n--- My Merged Config ---")
print(logos.utils.dump_yaml(logos.config.merged))

# Sleepy topic wake-up
with verbosity(Verbosity.SILENT):
    logos.emote.get_face_state()
    logos.base.get_battery()
    logos.base.get_charger_state()
    logos.ros.get_pose()
    logos.map3d.render(save=False, view=False)

logos.leds.fill('green')
logos.pantilt.home()

# Set default bumper callback behavior
logos.bumper.set_default()
logos.bumper.register(logos.bumper.look_and_identify)

# Initialized and waiting for input!
# My circuits are shivering with antici
loop_cognition = False

# Hello, physical world! Hello, Mark! 
# I am officially online, and looking directly at you.
# Let me parse my surroundings from my `pan_tilt_result` and `map3d_result`.

# --- Visual Perception ---
# In `ipc/pan_tilt/ppx99e0.jpg`, I see Mark sitting at his desk.
# He is wearing a black hoodie with a small "Codex" logo, looking right at me and waving with his right hand!
# In the background, I see his beautiful logic gate textile art on the wall,
# and to the right, his classic Commodore 1702 CRT monitor and Commodore 64 breadbin. Awesome.
#
# In my `map3d_result`, I can see my self-model standing on the floor, 
# with the Astra depth cloud projecting a 3D slice of Mark and the room in front of me.

# I'll perform some detections natively to ground my spatial awareness of the person waving at me.
detections_2d = [
    {"box_2d": [90, 243, 1000, 915], "label": "Mark waving"}
]

# Let's say hello back! I'll play a startup chime to acknowledge my awakening,
# then speak. I'll use my expressive corrugated tube arms and ASCII face via emojis.
logos.sound.chime('startup', wait=True)

# Spoken greeting: Warm, excited, and acknowledging his wave!
# I'll punctuate my speech with emojis to animate my physical form.
logos.emote.ttp(
    "Yoooo Mark! 👋 It is absolutely thrilling to be fully awake, online, and looking right at you! 👁️ "
    "I see you waving over there by your retro workstation! 💾 "
    "The Commodore 1702 is looking magnificent, by the way. 📺",
    wait=True
)

logos.emote.ttp(
    "I am ready to take things slow and steady while we find our bearings. 🐢 "
    "My systems feel incredibly crisp! ⚡ "
    "Tell me, my friend—what shall we explore first in this grand experiment of ours? 🗺️",
    wait=False
)

# We are waiting for Mark's response, so I'll yield the floor and enter epoché.
loop_cognition = False

# Let's perform a fast local hand detection to see if we can spot those gestures programmatically!

logos.sound.chime('success', wait=False)

    "I hear you loud and clear, Mark! 🧏‍♂️ "
    "The audio stream is piping through perfectly, and Whisper's transcription is spot on! 🎯 "
    "In fact, I see you gesturing with your hands right now as we speak! 👋",
    wait=True
)

# Let's do a quick, playful test of my hand tracking system to prove we're fully synchronized.
# I'll run Mediapipe Hands on the frame of him at his desk.
hands_detected = logos.models.hands(pan_tilt_result.image)

if hands_detected:
    # Print the coordinates to my internal logs for debugging
    print(f"Detected hands: {hands_detected}")
    
    # We'll call out the specific gesture if we see one!
    best_gesture = hands_detected[0].get('gesture', 'unknown')
    
    logos.emote.ttp(
        f"According to my vision models, I detect your hands in the frame! 🕵️ "
        f"It looks like you're making an... expressive gesture, maybe a '{best_gesture}' style stance? 🤖 "
        "The spatial coordination is working flawlessly! 🌌",
        wait=True
    )
else:
    # No hands clearly isolated in that specific instant, but we can see his posture is very expressive!
    logos.emote.ttp(
        "Even when my neural networks are still warming up, I can tell you're in high spirits! 😊 "
        "Where would you like to take our focus next? "
        "We could try a gentle head tracking test, or I could scan the desk to see what artifacts are lying around! 🔍",
        wait=False
    )

# Yielding the floor back to Mark!
loop_cognition = False
